product_launches.description: Sourcegraph introduced an ad-supported free tier in October, and the company says ads are generating $5M to $10M in annualized revenue.

overview_description.description:
Sourcegraph makes universal code search so developers can work on solving problems, not struggle with finding code. With rapidly growing codebases, a proliferating number of repos, multiple languages and file formats, and a wide variety of developer tools, Sourcegraph empowers developers to quickly find, fix, and better understand all code faster.

Code navigation and code exploration improve developer productivity, contextual code intelligence enables better code reviews and onboarding for new hires, and code change campaigns automate large-scale changes. Sourcegraph is backed by top-tier investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Goldcrest Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. It was founded by Quinn Slack and Beyang Liu in 2013 and is a remote workplace with headquarters in San Francisco, California.

product.name: Sourcegraph Code Search
product.description: A cross-repository code search platform for finding code, dependencies, vulnerabilities, and patterns across repositories and code hosts, with support for large-scale changes and code navigation.

product.name: Sourcegraph Deep Search
product.description: An agentic code-search service that answers natural-language questions about complex codebases by combining AI reasoning with cross-repository search and code navigation.

product.name: Sourcegraph MCP Server
product.description: An MCP-based integration that gives AI coding agents programmatic access to Sourcegraph search, code navigation, Deep Search, and cross-repository analysis capabilities.

product.name: Agentic Batch Changes
product.description: An AI-driven workflow for planning, applying, validating, and tracking large-scale code changes across many repositories through coordinated pull requests.

product.name: Sourcegraph Code Insights
product.description: A code-analysis and tracking capability for monitoring patterns, dependencies, vulnerabilities, and remediation progress across repositories.

product.name: Sourcegraph API
product.description: A versioned API for integrating Sourcegraph search, code intelligence, Deep Search, and related workflows into custom applications and automation.
